gaps.valueSet: Numeric MERS-CoV antibody result greater than zero
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no unit-aware numeric laboratory comparison predicate; source rule 3 retains its coded-positive, organism-result, and abnormal-interpretation alternatives

SEM_V1 cannot represent confirmed-case contact, contact with a symptomatic traveler, severe-respiratory-illness cluster membership, recent travel, or recent healthcare-facility exposure; at least one epidemiologic fact is required by every source rule 4-8, so those rules are omitted entirely

gaps.valueSet: Body Temperature greater than 38 C or 100.4 F
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no unit-aware numeric vital-sign comparison predicate; this is one fever alternative within omitted source rule 5

gaps.valueSet: Chest imaging with interpretation consistent with pneumonia
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks the imaging finding unavailable because impressions are narrative rather than coded, and SEM_V1 has no imaging evidence; source rule 8 is omitted entirely
